title: Student-personalized Parsons problem generation
summary: Students use PuzzleMakerPy to generate Parsons problems by selecting a personal context and programming topic. They then arrange the generated code fragments into a correct sequence and evaluate the relevance of the tailored exercise.

sources.title: From Automation to Cognition: Redefining the Roles of Educators and Generative AI in Computing Education
sources.evidence_quote: Using a custom tool called PuzzleMakerPy, we allowed students to generate personalized Parsons Problems.
